purpose: This table provides cleaned FAA aircraft registry attributes (manufacture year, type, manufacturer, model, engine configuration, seat count, and cruising speed) for the tail numbers observed among 2013 NYC flights, feeding downstream joins on tailnum for fleet and aircraft-characteristic analysis.
usage: Join on tailnum to enrich flight records with plane_type, manufacturer, model, engine_count, seat_count, engine_type, year_manufactured, and speed_mph; consumers must explicitly handle nulls in speed_mph (present for well under 1% of rows) and year_manufactured (about 2.1% null) rather than assuming zero or imputing a value.
limitations: speed_mph is populated for only 23 of 3322 rows (null_rate 0.993076), making it unsuitable for broad analysis without acknowledging its sparsity; year_manufactured has a smaller but real gap (null_rate 0.021072, 70 nulls); per operator context, American Airlines and Envoy Air aircraft are absent from this registry extract because those carriers reported fleet numbers rather than tail numbers, so this table cannot resolve plane attributes for their flights.
